chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 27: Han Li Prepares Sacred Elixirs
chapter_meta_description: Han Li uses the mysterious bottle to accelerate rare herbs and concocts legendary medicines that will break through cultivation bottlenecks and save his life.
og_description: With a deadline looming and a bottle of liquid time in hand, Han Li becomes the sect's most ruthless pharmacist.
twitter_description: No fights. Just Han Li scheming, counting his green liquid drops, and cooking up elixirs that would bankrupt a sect. Pure resource-management bliss.
